# GK Batteries

> GK Batteries is a multi-brand battery and inverter dealer in Alnavar, Dharwad District, Karnataka, run by owner Gous Khan. More than 50 years of hands-on battery experience — owner Gous Khan built hard-rubber (HR) batteries by hand while working in other stores, then opened his own GK Batteries store in Alnavar in 1994 and became an authorized dealer for Exide, Amaron, SF, Yokohama and Dynex. Two branches, free delivery within 20 km, jump start on NH-67, old-battery exchange and home inverter installation. Call 94486 67528.

Key facts: authorised dealer for Exide, Amaron, SF Sonic, Yokohama and Dynex. Sells car, two-wheeler, SUV, tractor, truck, e-rickshaw and home inverter batteries. Two branches in Alnavar 581103 — NH-67 Goa Cross (highway service) and Azad Road (sales, service, installation). Open Monday to Sunday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM. Languages: English, Kannada, Hindi. Payment: cash, UPI, cards, bank transfer.

## Services

- Jump start service and roadside battery replacement on NH-67 (Alnavar–Goa, Londa routes)
- Car, bike, SUV, tractor, truck and e-rickshaw battery sales with old-battery exchange
- Home inverter battery supply, sizing, installation and wiring (100Ah–220Ah tubular and maintenance-free)
- On-field tractor battery delivery and installation
- Agri sprayer pump battery sales, repair and replacement
- Battery rental for weddings, functions, events and emergencies
- Battery charging, health check, terminal cleaning and water top-up
- Free doorstep delivery and installation within 20 km of Alnavar

## Branches

- Highway branch — NH-67, Goa Cross, Alnavar, Dharwad District, Karnataka 581103. Jump start, instant battery swaps, emergency roadside assistance.
- Local hub — Azad Road, Alnavar Town, Dharwad District, Karnataka 581103. Battery sales, inverter installation, charging, rental, repair, agri sprayer pump service.

## Service area

Alnavar, Ramapur, Mugad, Kakkeri, Tamboor, Londa, Khanapur, Bailhongal, Dharwad, Hubli, Belgaum (Belagavi), Gadag, Ponda, Panaji, Vasco da Gama, Kolhapur.

## Owner

Gous Khan — Founder & Owner, since 1994. Built hard-rubber (HR) batteries by hand while working in other stores, mastered the industry shift to modern poly-cased, tubular and maintenance-free (VRLA) chemistry, then opened his own GK Batteries store in Alnavar in 1994 and moved into authorised retail distribution.
